newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi profit growth lags deliveries in Jan/Feb.
newsitem.headline: Audi profit growth lags deliveries in Jan/Feb.

text.p: Audi AG management board chairman Herbert Demel said on Tuesday that profit growth in the first two months of this year was far slower than the growth in customer vehicle deliveries in the two-month period.
"We do not provide monthly profit results, but you can assume that profit growth was far slower than customer vehicle deliveries in January and February," Demel said.
Audi said earlier on Tuesday that worldwide customer deliveries rose 32 pct to 89,368 units in January and February. Sales rose 15 pct to 3.32 billion marks.
Demel said that the initial 1997 results benefited from a backlog from 1996.
